_README: Every number here must be traceable to an official source. Do not add a number you cannot cite. Numbers below the national level change frequently by district and by facility, so this file links to the official directories that publish them rather than reprinting digits that may be stale. Re-verify before each release and update verified_on.
verification_status: UNVERIFIED BY REPOSITORY OWNER. These were compiled from public web sources and have not been confirmed against the official directories by a human. Confirm every entry before this page is published or promoted.

national.label: Emergency, from any mobile
national.detail: Use when you cannot recall the specific number

disaster_hotline.status: CONFLICTING SOURCES — VERIFY BEFORE RELYING ON THIS
disaster_hotline.explanation: The National Emergency Operation Centre's own site lists 1149 as its toll-free disaster hotline. Separately, a July 2026 news report attributed to a Ministry of Home Affairs press release states that 1149 was replaced by 1234, which now routes Kathmandu Valley calls to NEOC and calls from the other 74 districts to the respective District Emergency Operation Centre. These two accounts cannot both be current. This has not been resolved against a primary MoHA source.

candidates.label: NEOC disaster hotline (as published by NEOC)
Disaster hotline (reported replacement, routed to DEOC by district)
candidates.source: News report citing an MoHA press release, July 2026

disaster_hotline.guidance: Until this is resolved with MoHA or NEOC directly, the interface shows both and tells the user to try 100 or 112 if neither connects.

institutions.name: National Emergency Operation Centre (NEOC)
institutions.role: Coordinates national disaster response under the Ministry of Home Affairs
institutions.note: The NEOC page carrying these numbers also contains district lists dated 2014, so the page may not be actively maintained. Confirm by phone before operational use.

institutions.name: National Earthquake Monitoring and Research Centre (NEMRC / National Seismological Centre)
institutions.role: Nepal's official earthquake monitoring body; publishes the national catalogue
institutions.parent: Department of Mines and Geology, Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Supplies

institutions.name: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA)
institutions.role: Publishes official casualty, rescue and relief figures during a disaster
institutions.note: Treat NDRRMA situation reports as the authoritative source for impact figures. Always check the timestamp; early counts move.

district_level.note: District Emergency Operation Centres (DEOCs) exist in every district, but their direct numbers change and no machine-readable national directory of them was located. Rather than print digits that may be wrong when someone needs them most, this tool routes users to the national numbers and to the official directories below.

operational_advice: Save 100 and 112 to your phone now. A stored contact does not need a network.
Mobile networks congest during a large event. If one line is busy, try another.
This page is a planning and situational-awareness tool. It is not an alerting system and must not be relied on for warning.
